timeline.cite: App A; LotR V.9 [I-M] — the OPENING year is the archive's own placement. NO ANNAL DATES THE RAID: App A narrates it without a year — 'he came to Umbar unlooked for by night, and there burned a great part of the ships of the Corsairs' — and the Tale of Years' Umbar annals are all centuries earlier: T.A. 933, 1015, 1448, 1540 and 1810 (plus S.A. 2280 and 3261), none of them within 1,100 years of Thorongil's raid. The closing year is sound: the Corsairs' end at Pelargir is March 3019, LotR V.9
timeline.what: Thorongil's raid burns the fleet; the Corsairs' last armament dies at Pelargir
